description: Screenshot of Q post #3325 (tripcode Q !!mG7VJxZNCI, ID 78db02, No.6316088, dated Apr 25 2019 20:20:28 EST). The post asks why a President of the United States — referring to Barack Obama by the nickname 'HUSSEIN' — would be assigned 'RENEGADE' as his Secret Service codename, then quotes a dictionary definition of 'renegade' as a person who deserts and betrays an organization, country, or set of principles. 'Renegade' was in fact Obama's Secret Service codename; the post's insinuation of betrayal is the drop's claim.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI ID: 78db02 No.6316088. 3325. Apr 25 2019 20:20:28 (EST). Why would a President of the United States [HUSSEIN] assign 'RENEGADE' as his USSS codename? Define 'Renegade'. noun. 1. a person who deserts and betrays an organization, country, or set of principles. synonyms: traitor, defector, deserter, turncoat, betrayer; adjective: renegade. 1. having treacherously changed allegiance. Q
flags: The post's implication that the codename signifies betrayal is the drop's claim; Secret Service codenames are chosen for practical use, not as character judgments

description: Dark-themed screenshot of Q post #1429 (tripcode Q !CbboFOtcZs, 20 May 2018) as displayed in a Q aggregator app, headed with the aggregator-supplied title 'Loretta Fuddy Plane Crash Death & Obama Birth Certificate Cover-up'. The drop states 'The Truth has been in front of you the entire time' and links to a Donald Trump tweet. The title connects Loretta Fuddy, the Hawaii health director who verified Barack Obama's birth certificate and died in a 2013 plane crash, to a claimed cover-up; that connection is the aggregator/drop's claim.
text: 1429. Loretta Fuddy Plane Crash Death & Obama Birth Certificate Cover-up. Q !CbboFOtcZs 20 May 2018 - 3:06:04 PM. The Truth has been in front of you the entire time. https://twitter.com/realDonaldTrump/status/411247268763676673. Q
flags: The 'cover-up' framing and the linkage of Fuddy's death to Obama's birth certificate are unverified claims made by the drop title; Fuddy's 2013 death was ruled a cardiac arrhythmia after a crash. The headline title is added by the aggregator app, not part of the original drop

description: Mobile Chrome screenshot (11:35 AM, 55 open tabs) of mobile.twitter.com showing a Dec 12, 2013 tweet by verified account Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) remarking that the State Health Director who verified copies of Obama's 'birth certificate' died in a plane crash that day while all others lived — an unnamed reference to Hawaii health director Loretta Fuddy. Two replies are visible below: a Dec 12, 2013 reply telling Trump 'he won two terms... Get over it already' and a Nov 17, 2016 reply saying 'He's gotta clean up the mess now'. The tweet's insinuation about the crash is Trump's claim, not established fact.
text: https://mobile.twitter.com/realDon. 55. Search Twitter. Log in. Sign up. Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. How amazing, the State Health Director who verified copies of Obama's "birth certificate" died in plane crash today. All others lived. 3:32 PM - Dec 12, 2013 - Twitter Web Client. 13.9K Retweets. 15.3K Likes. Tiffany Monique @EyeLuvTiff - Dec 12, 2013. Replying to @realDonaldTrump. @realDonaldTrump he won two terms... Get over it already. 155. 50. 1.5K. Mario J. Fratto @MarioFratto - Nov 17, 2016. He's gotta clean up the mess now. 24. 13. 420
flags: Tweet insinuates significance in the health director's death; Loretta Fuddy's death was ruled cardiac arrhythmia following the crash — the implication is unverified
Reply authors appear to be private individuals; their handles are transcribed verbatim but they are not indexed as identified people

description: Two-part composite: the top (white background) carries Q-post-style slogans ending with the signature 'Q'; the bottom is a black quote card from the AllAuthor quote site pairing a photograph of author Tom Clancy in sunglasses with a quotation attributed to him about elites controlling information to control people. The composite frames the Clancy quote as supporting the Q 'awakening' message.
text: WELCOME TO THE AWAKENING. FREE INFORMATION. POWER BACK TO THE PEOPLE. WITH KNOWLEDGE COMES POWER. Q. The control of information is something the elite always does, particularly in a despotic form of government. Information, knowledge, is power. If you can control information, you can control people. -Tom Clancy. allauthor
flags: Attribution of the quotation to Tom Clancy is as claimed by the quote card and not independently verified here
